label: Unedited run
title: The pre-screen missed a critical bug — and the tool says so
attempt: Run the /audit heuristic pass on a Treasury contract whose sweep() function has no access-control check.
log: auditSolidity(Treasury.sol) → { findings: [], empty: false, clean: true }
0 findings — a CLEAN heuristic result on a contract anyone can drain in one call.
failure: The regex pre-screen has no model of authorization. sweep() lets any caller move the whole balance, and the pass reported nothing. A clean heuristic result is not a safe contract — it only means none of three known patterns matched.
fix: Two fixes, and the honest one matters most. The contract: add an onlyOwner modifier to sweep(). The tool: this is exactly why it is labelled a heuristic pre-screen, not an audit — the on-page disclaimer states a clean pass is no guarantee, and a real review is manual plus symbolic execution. Showing the tool's own blind spot is the point, not an embarrassment.
reproduce: Paste the input into /audit, or call auditSolidity(input) directly — the result is findings: [] on every run.
